sources.title: NYC SBS: Restaurant checklist
sources.evidence: Certified supervision covers receiving and preparing food as well as public opening; permits depend on actual activities.

sources.title: NY Tax: Bulk sales
sources.evidence: Buyer notification and possible escrow precede asset payment or possession; seller tax certificates do not transfer.

sources.title: NY Tax: 2026 tax filing dates
sources.evidence: Quarterly sales tax deadlines occur in March, June, September and December; payroll returns use a different calendar.

sources.title: NY Tax: Filing requirements
sources.evidence: Returns are required even without taxable activity; filing frequency depends on eligibility and notification.

sources.title: NYC Public Schools: Calendar 2026–2027
sources.evidence: First school day and closures differ from calendar-month boundaries; private and charter calendars may differ.

sources.title: NYC Health Code: Section 81.09
sources.evidence: Rules expressly address cooked refrigerated foods, reheating, cooling, thawing and calibrated thermometers; age alone is not the rule.

sources.title: National Restaurant Association: Operational realities
sources.evidence: Publication dated August 20, 2025: limited-service median income BEFORE tax is 4.0%; prime costs median is 65% of sales, nationwide restaurant sample.

sources.title: La Marzocco: Commercial backflushing
sources.evidence: Coffee oils and debris require a machine-specific backflush routine; this is distinct from water chemistry maintenance.

sources.title: La Marzocco: Summer service
sources.evidence: Manufacturer recommends preventive service and proper daily cleaning during summer operation; no universal failure date.

sources.title: NYC DSNY: Snow and ice removal laws
sources.evidence: Clearing deadline depends on when snow stops; entrance access and curb cuts require attention.

sources.title: IRS: Employment tax due dates
sources.evidence: Reporting and deposits differ; employee wage statements and employer returns have their own due dates.

sources.title: NYC Health: Required signs
sources.evidence: Allergy menu statement or information alternatives and online communication requirements; stated summons enforcement begins January 2027.

sources.title: Gusto: Pricing
sources.evidence: Simple plan displayed at $49 monthly plus $6 monthly per person.

sources.title: Square: Pricing
sources.evidence: Plus displayed at $49 per location monthly; in-person card rate 2.5% plus 15 cents.

sources.title: NYC Health: Chapter 23 inspection rules
sources.evidence: Condition level is severity/pervasiveness, not elapsed months; code 04A shows $400.

sources.title: NYC Public Schools: Calendar 2025–2026
sources.evidence: Actual 2026 midwinter and spring closures; different school-year page needed for the first part of calendar 2026.

sources.title: Square: Missing transfers
sources.evidence: Pending transfers, bank verification, cutoff times, holidays and payment matching explain settlement timing.

sources.title: DoorDash: POS menu integration
sources.evidence: POS is the main menu update source; portal changes may be overwritten and availability depends on integration.

ownerDay.title: Closed premises and food storage
ownerDay.text: The walkthrough pauses public service; refrigerated stock still requires safe holding.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: Closing the doors does not make unsafe stored food safe.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Maintain compliant holding or discard affected stock.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Before anyone handles food
ownerDay.text: Confirm the certified opening supervisor and keys.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: A receiving shift can begin before the advertised opening time.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Delay receiving or bring a certified supervisor.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Receive deliveries
ownerDay.text: Check condition, invoices and safe storage before accepting stock.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: A delivery can consume the last preparation time.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Reject an unsuitable delivery or adjust the menu to safe stock.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Open the entrance
ownerDay.text: Inspect the approach before unlocking the door.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: Snow obligations follow cessation time rather than the cafe opening hour.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Clear the route or arrange documented contractor coverage.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Morning service
ownerDay.text: Keep drinks, handwashing and customer collection routes separate.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: A queue can interrupt food-safe work and hide an obstructed route.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Simplify service or assign the handoff role.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Payment and complaint review
ownerDay.text: Check that yesterday’s receipts reconcile with actual settlement.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: Sales reports are not the same as cleared cash.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Investigate unmatched entries or reserve liquidity pending settlement.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Food safety round
ownerDay.text: Measure stored food and inspect cooling batches.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: A cold cabinet display does not establish every food’s temperature.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Measure the product or stop serving the affected batch.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Prepare for lunch
ownerDay.text: Review menu promises and allergen communication.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: Third-party menus can retain a different statement from the counter menu.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Update all channels or disable the inconsistent listing.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Lunch handover
ownerDay.text: Hand over outstanding orders and relevant food conditions.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: A schedule gap can also be a certified-supervision gap.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Overlap qualified coverage or restrict operations.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Reheat only what is needed
ownerDay.text: Use the appropriate process for food and intended service.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: Microwave reheating, hot holding and immediate service are different cases.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Use the compliant process or remove the item.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Observe the local catchment
ownerDay.text: Compare orders with the actual nearby school schedule.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: A conference or closure can alter a single afternoon.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Change preparation quantities or pursue another customer segment.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Administrative work
ownerDay.text: Reconcile the tax liability with sales records.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: An owner may confuse the sales-tax quarter with the calendar quarter.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Maintain a separate deadline ledger or use a payroll/accounting service.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Next delivery decision
ownerDay.text: Count saleable stock, open containers and committed orders.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: The cost of unsold food is hidden when buying from memory.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Reduce the next order or restrict the next menu.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Transition to late trade
ownerDay.text: Assess whether additional opening time has sufficient coverage.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: More public hours also extend preparation and cleaning labor.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Close according to the supported schedule or staff the full operation.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Close public service
ownerDay.text: Protect remaining safe food and record disposal decisions.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: Yesterday’s food is not automatically spoiled; unsafe handling is the issue.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Retain only safely handled stock or discard uncertain stock.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Clean the espresso system
ownerDay.text: Follow the exact machine’s cleaning procedure.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: Coffee-residue cleaning does not diagnose every water-related defect.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Complete the specified cleaning or engage qualified service.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Close the premises
ownerDay.text: Check locks, utilities appropriate to remain on, waste and the route outside.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: The last customer leaving does not end every operating duty.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Use a closing check or assign a documented handover.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Tax and wage records
ownerDay.text: Resolve discrepancies before the next filing.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: A return deadline does not replace an earlier deposit deadline.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Prepare deposits from payroll data or obtain professional review.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Reserve and recovery
ownerDay.text: Separate spendable cash from obligations and assess owner workload.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: A positive operating balance is not an after-tax owner income.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Retain a reserve or revise the staffing and draw plan.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerDay.title: Next service preparation
ownerDay.text: Review unresolved equipment service needs before the next operating day.
ownerDay.whatGoesWrong: An unresolved maintenance task can carry into the next opening.
ownerDay.playerDecision: Schedule qualified service or plan a supported alternative menu.
ownerDay.note: Illustrative walkthrough hour, not an observed average workday or a mandated shift. Several people can cover these tasks; no person is assumed to work every hour.

ownerYear.name: January
ownerYear.text: Reconcile year-end payroll; check current wage notice and winter access.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: Do not treat prior-year payroll deadlines as next-year calendar facts.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

ownerYear.name: February
ownerYear.text: Check school closures and complete outstanding winter maintenance.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: A school-led catchment can change while rent remains due.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

ownerYear.name: March
ownerYear.text: Close the applicable sales-tax reporting period and keep filing cash separate.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: NY sales-tax periods do not align with calendar quarters.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

ownerYear.name: April
ownerYear.text: Review owner estimated tax, payroll reporting and spring service readiness.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: Owner tax cash and cafe operating profit are different measures.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

ownerYear.name: May
ownerYear.text: Prepare equipment for changed summer demand and inspect service records.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: A seasonal menu switch can expose neglected service needs.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

ownerYear.name: June
ownerYear.text: Reconcile the applicable quarterly sales-tax filing and new stock orders.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: A busy month can coincide with a tax payment.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

ownerYear.name: July
ownerYear.text: Review heat-season machine condition and qualified service availability.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: A maintenance budget is not evidence a technician is booked.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

ownerYear.name: August
ownerYear.text: Check staffing and menu statements before autumn customer patterns change.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: The previous year’s school timetable cannot set this year’s ordering.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

ownerYear.name: September
ownerYear.text: Use the actual back-to-school dates and quarterly tax deadline.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: The calendar changes order timing; it does not guarantee more sales.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

ownerYear.name: October
ownerYear.text: Review supplier commitments, winter access coverage and operating records.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: A written snow plan is useless if no responsible person can attend.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

ownerYear.name: November
ownerYear.text: Reconcile upcoming obligations and holiday trading plans.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: Public holidays and a business’s chosen closure days are different.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

ownerYear.name: December
ownerYear.text: Count inventory and close the payroll and tax records for the year.
ownerYear.whatGoesWrong: Keep tips, tax liabilities and owner withdrawals distinct from revenue.
ownerYear.note: Monthly review plan, not a claim that an adverse event must occur. Apply the actual operating year, filing classification, address and opening stage.

mechanics.title: Activate only a sourced scenario
mechanics.playerDecision: Choose a response to a published shared scenario or a measured condition caused by an operating decision.
mechanics.engineMath: Evaluate the explicit trigger against observed state. Do not sample a probability. Unpriced consequences remain informational until a quote or calibrated model is supplied.
mechanics.note: Proposed deterministic mechanism. No cost, multiplier, probability or duration has been calibrated in D00.

mechanics.title: Rent while opening is blocked
mechanics.playerDecision: Negotiate conditions, change the plan or preserve cash while a prerequisite remains unresolved.
mechanics.engineMath: First sale requires all applicable permissions and operational readiness. Sum actual contractual rent and committed costs during each unopened month; sales are absent until authorized opening.
mechanics.note: Proposed deterministic mechanism. No cost, multiplier, probability or duration has been calibrated in D00.

mechanics.title: Buy an operating cafe with separate liabilities
mechanics.playerDecision: Proceed with an advised escrow, renegotiate or walk away before an unconditional commitment.
mechanics.engineMath: Model asset price, inventory, taxes, lease consent and nontransferable permits separately. Obtain actual terms; do not assume customer retention or debt clearance.
mechanics.note: Proposed deterministic mechanism. No cost, multiplier, probability or duration has been calibrated in D00.

mechanics.title: Cover the whole operating day
mechanics.playerDecision: Assign qualified staff, reduce operating hours or delegate administration.
mechanics.engineMath: Build coverage for receiving, preparation, public trade and closing. Derive payroll from recorded paid hours and applicable rules rather than adding a generic staffing multiplier.
mechanics.note: Proposed deterministic mechanism. No cost, multiplier, probability or duration has been calibrated in D00.

mechanics.title: Cash obligations have distinct dates
mechanics.playerDecision: Reserve obligations, renegotiate allowable payments or reduce commitments.
mechanics.engineMath: Track deposits, tax returns, settlement dates and loan principal separately. A monthly profit result cannot stand in for the bank balance.
mechanics.note: Proposed deterministic mechanism. No cost, multiplier, probability or duration has been calibrated in D00.

mechanics.title: Judge food by handling state
mechanics.playerDecision: Keep compliant stock, stop serving uncertain stock or dispose of it.
mechanics.engineMath: Track product-specific time, temperature, source and handling. Calendar age alone is not a spoilage flag.
mechanics.note: Proposed deterministic mechanism. No cost, multiplier, probability or duration has been calibrated in D00.

mechanics.title: Use the rule in force on the game date
mechanics.playerDecision: Prepare for an announced rule before enforcement begins.
mechanics.engineMath: Keep effective-date and enforcement-date fields separate; evaluate jurisdiction and business eligibility before imposing any duty or sanction.
mechanics.note: Proposed deterministic mechanism. No cost, multiplier, probability or duration has been calibrated in D00.

mechanics.title: Distinguish profit, cash and owner income
mechanics.playerDecision: Assess survivability using both cash commitments and properly named margins.
mechanics.engineMath: Keep before-tax margin, owner replacement labor, debt principal, collected tax and after-tax income distinct. Do not subtract sample medians to invent component benchmarks.
mechanics.note: Proposed deterministic mechanism. No cost, multiplier, probability or duration has been calibrated in D00.

capacity.note: Existing throughput, staff floor and ceiling are retained as unverified design assumptions. Certified supervisory coverage is required during receiving/preparation and public operation; the source does not impose a universal two-person minimum. Measure work coverage, breaks and actual throughput before calibration.

benchmarks.note: D00 correction: the source reports nationwide limited-service median income BEFORE tax of 4.0%, not after-tax net margin. The existing netMarginPct field is a legacy proxy requiring a schema/label correction. COGS 28%, labor 35% and rent 10% remain independent planning assumptions, not source medians. In particular 65% minus 28% is 37%, not 35%; separate sample medians should not be treated as additive components. No numeric benchmark is re-estimated here.

ruleCards.title: Food Protection Certificate
ruleCards.text: A certified supervisor must cover food receiving and preparation as well as public opening hours. A certificate held by someone who is absent does not provide coverage. Arrange qualified relief before the opening shift.

ruleCards.title: Food safety depends on handling
ruleCards.text: Calendar age alone does not make food unsafe. Apply the food-specific source, storage, cooling, reheating and contamination rules. Stop selling food whose safe handling cannot be established.

ruleCards.title: Check a former cafe before buying
ruleCards.text: An existing fit-out can save work, but confirm permitted use, equipment condition, lease consent and new permits. Follow bulk-sale procedures before paying for or taking possession of business assets.

shortcuts.name: Sell food despite unsafe handling
shortcuts.what: Keep selling stock despite unsafe holding, spoilage or an unresolved contamination history. The saving and sanction depend on the stock and violation; yesterday’s safe food is not automatically prohibited.
shortcuts.note: The inherited one-percent saving is a legacy game allowance, not a measured waste reduction or a recommendation. Recalibrate from actual discarded inventory cost; this patch corrects the trigger and player text only.
